Ellie Cho: hey team! i’m ellie, starting today as a product analyst on Growth. remote first week — quick setup q: my laptop status still says 'awaiting ship' on the portal. should i expect it this week? who do I ask about VPN/VPC access for test-data buckets? also where do i get access to the shared research drive? fun fact: i fold origami animals while on calls (i promise i listen), and i have a pet turtle named Mochi. :turtle:

Samir Rao: welcome ellie!! i’m your onboarding buddy. i’ll run a repo walk-through tomorrow morning. for buckets/VPC ping eng-infra-bot and Carlos in infra. if you want, we can schedule a quick VPN setup session later today. :rocket:

Maya Thompson: hi ellie :wave: — People Ops here. i sent a short survey about your workstation preferences. also there should be an invite to our team channel and the growth dashboards, let me know if you don’t see them. lunch question: do you prefer vegetarian or omnivore snack boxes?

Ellie Cho: thanks samir/maya! i picked veg on the survey. i don't see the repo org invite yet. i can do a VPN session later today at 3pm PT.

it-helpdesk: Ticket IT-5012 created for Ellie Cho: "New hire laptop shipment and temp access". Status: Provisioned temporary cloud instance (ubuntu-22.04). SSH: ellie@temp-dev-210.redwood.internal. Key placed in 1Password -> "IT Temp Keys".

eng-infra-bot: Added Ellie Cho to org "redwood-inference". Teams assigned: growth-analytics, growth-readonly. Please accept the GitHub invite from your email.

Samir Rao: i invited you to a 3pm PT VPN + credentials session. i'll drop a short checklist in the calendar invite: MDM enrol, accept GitHub, 1password setup, join #growth and #product-questions.

Ellie Cho: got the calendar invite, thanks! i accepted the GitHub invite. the temp SSH worked fine. any recommended dashboards or docs to skim before the team intro?

Maya Thompson: start with growth/README and the dashboard index: https://intranet.redwood.com/growth-dashboards. also watch the 10m intro video in that folder for a quick tour.

Nora (People Ops): welcome again ellie! FYI we have a virtual new-hire coffee tomorrow at 11am PT where folks share one thing they're learning. would love you to bring Mochi (photo) or an origami mascot :smile:

Ellie Cho: will do — sending a pic of Mochi and my crane after the 11am coffee. excited to be here and meet everyone!
